t: You're standing at Eccleston Square, a garden square in Pimlico. Several people have lived on this square over the years. Humphry Ward, an author and journalist, lived here; he's best known as the husband of the novelist Mrs Humphry Ward. John Pitt Taylor, a jurist, and George Charles Colville also lived here. Thomas William Bramston died here; he was the Member of Parliament for South Essex for thirty years and a noted breeder of cattle. Another resident, M. W. Hallett, was a theatrical amateur who lived here in the 1850s.
